question: What is the primary benefit of electronic communication in clinical practice?

options.A: Reduction of face-to-face patient interaction time
options.B: Faster sharing of patient data among staff
options.C: Lowering the cost of hospital building maintenance
options.D: Elimination of all charting errors in the ward

explanation: Digital tools allow multiple practitioners to access health records and updates simultaneously across different departments. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: A major risk introduced by adopting digital communication channels in healthcare is...

options.A: Mandatory printing of all text messages for files
options.B: Total loss of verbal communication skills in nurses
options.C: Increased vulnerability to patient data privacy breaches
options.D: Unavoidable delays in emergency surgical procedures

explanation: The speed and digital storage of electronic data create pathways for unauthorized access if security protocols fail. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h1)

question: A broadcast messaging group in a hospital setting is best used for...

options.A: One-way announcements from management to staff
options.B: Direct video calls with patients in private wards
options.C: Personal chats between nurses during night shifts
options.D: Private debates on patient diagnosis among doctors

explanation: Broadcast groups allow administrators to push important updates and schedules to a large group efficiently. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: What type of messaging should a ward nurse use to discuss a sensitive patient condition with the attending physician?

options.B: Printed notice board in the hallway

explanation: Private clinical details require a one-on-one secure channel to maintain confidentiality and comply with privacy laws. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h2)

question: Why are video conferencing tools particularly useful for rural healthcare delivery in Nigeria?

options.A: They completely replace the need for physical nurses on site
options.B: They eliminate the need for any internet connection at all
options.C: They allow remote clinics to consult urban specialists easily
options.D: They automatically dispense medications to distant patients

explanation: Video links bridge the distance between remote primary care centers and urban tertiary hospitals for expert advice. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: Which video platform is typically known for deep integration within a hospital's enterprise software ecosystem?
explanation: Microsoft Teams often bundles with institutional IT setups, connecting administrative and clinical workflows seamlessly. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of a Learning Management System like Moodle in nursing education?

options.A: To monitor live patient vital signs in the intensive care unit
options.B: To schedule emergency ambulance dispatches across the city
options.C: To process hospital staff salaries and monthly tax deductions
options.D: To host course materials, assignments, and track student progress

explanation: Moodle and similar systems serve as digital classrooms for organizing educational content and tracking learner engagement. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: Asynchronous learning modules on an educational platform allow nursing students to...

options.A: Access course materials and study at their own convenience
options.B: Communicate instantly with patients admitted to the medical ward
options.C: Attend live lectures that require strict real-time attendance
options.D: Perform surgical procedures directly on virtual patients online

explanation: Asynchronous tools do not require everyone to log in at the same exact moment, offering flexibility for busy nursing students. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h4)

question: What action should a nurse take immediately after finishing charting on a shared ward computer?

options.A: Leave the browser open for the next shift
options.B: Log out of the user session completely
options.C: Turn off the main electrical power switch
options.D: Delete all operating system files on the desktop

explanation: Logging out prevents unauthorized persons from accessing open patient files on shared clinical workstations. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)

question: Why is it dangerous for nurses to use personal social media apps for discussing patient cases?

options.A: Hospital management cannot see how popular the nurse becomes online
options.B: Social media posts load much slower than official hospital software
options.C: Patients prefer reading medical notes printed on physical paper
options.D: Personal apps lack the secure encryption required for health data privacy

explanation: Public or consumer social apps do not meet legal health data standards, risking severe privacy violations. [learn more](GNS113_U3_T5#GNS113_U3_T5_h5)
